def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Separate the two panels and identify the color shared by both.
    sep_c = next((c for c in range(w)
                  if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))), None)

    if sep_c is not None:
        a = [row[:sep_c] for row in grid]
        b = [row[sep_c + 1:] for row in grid]
        common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
        color = min(common)
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
                 for c in range(min(len(a[r]), len(b[r])))]
                for r in range(h)]

    sep_r = next(r for r in range(h)
                 if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]))
    a, b = grid[:sep_r], grid[sep_r + 1:]
    common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    color = min(common)
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(min(len(a), len(b)))]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Locate the solid divider (vertical or horizontal).
    vc = next((c for c in range(w)
               if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if vc is not None:
        a = [row[:vc] for row in grid]
        b = [row[vc + 1:] for row in grid]
        height, width = h, min(vc, w - vc - 1)
    else:
        hr = next(r for r in range(h)
                  if len(set(grid[r])) == 1)
        a, b = grid[:hr], grid[hr + 1:]
        height, width = min(hr, h - hr - 1), w

    ca = set(v for row in a for v in row)
    cb = set(v for row in b for v in row)
    common = ca & cb
    from collections import Counter
    base = Counter(v for row in a for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    if common:
        base = max(common, key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in a)
                                      + sum(row.count(x) for row in b))

    return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else base
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(height)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w)
               if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)

    mark = next(v for v in counts if v != background)
    return [[3 if v == mark else mark for v in row] for row in panel]
